claims.claim: Contact us for ur Solar Energy Solution...
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photo does not show any matching offer details (wattage/brand/condition).

risks.risk: Wattage/size is unknown; price depends heavily on whether it’s 300W vs 400W vs 600W+.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the panel’s label/sticker showing wattage (W), brand, and model (usually on the back or near the frame).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case comparable for the lowest wattage shown in the market list (treat as a low-watt used panel).

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (could be damaged, cracked cells, or underperforming).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the panel under sunlight plus an output reading from a multimeter/solar tester (or a simple I-V curve reading if they have a tester).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed/used-worst-case (assume reduced performance).

risks.risk: Brand authenticity is unknown (photo doesn’t show Canadian Solar/Longi/Jinko/etc.).
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up of the brand/model text on the frame/back label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown used panel rather than premium brand.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/compatibility (MC4 connectors, junction box condition, cable length) can affect usability.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the junction box and the connector type (MC4 or other) and whether cables are included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as panel only (no guaranteed cables/connectors).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the panel’s back label/sticker showing: brand, model, rated wattage (W), voltage/current (Vmp/Imp), and serial number.
Send a close-up photo of the junction box and connectors (MC4 type) and confirm whether cables are included.
Send a short test clip showing output under sunlight (or a solar tester reading) to confirm it’s working and approximate performance.
response.reason: The photo shows a solar panel but the key pricing driver (brand/model/wattage label) is not readable, so a worst-case price cannot be reliably matched to the correct comparable.
